note: px = the @2x picture. su = stage units (280 x 300). anchor = the point of the picture that the scene places. mask = white + alpha, tinted by code. sizes / rots = steps the cache should hold (scale factors / number of angles round the circle).

files.note: frost creeping in from the corners; laid over the stage when FREEZE is on (tinted ice white). Half resolution: draw at twice its pixel size
